author: Lütken, 1852
evidence: FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic

note.en: A small speckled worm eel of estuaries and muddy sand, hidden in burrows; known here from a few museum records.
note.es: Una anguila gusano pequeña y pecosa de estuarios y arena lodosa, escondida en madrigueras; conocida aquí por unos pocos registros de museo.

recWhy: Museum records in the region, sites not stated.

marks.en: Slender worm-like eel with fine speckles, brown above.
marks.es: Anguila delgada parecida a un gusano, con puntos finos, parda por encima.
